scripts.setup: docker compose up --build -d db && docker compose run --rm api npm run db:setup --workspace api && docker compose up --build -d --force-recreate --renew-anon-volumes
scripts.setup:migrate: docker compose exec api npm run db:migrate --workspace api
scripts.setup:seed: docker compose exec api npm run db:seed --workspace api
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage --workspace api && npm run test:coverage --workspace web && node scripts/coverage-summary.mjs
scripts.test:e2e: docker compose exec web npm run test:e2e:docker
scripts.test:e2e:docker: sh -c 'VITE_API_URL=http://api:3000 npm run dev --workspace web -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port 4173 >/tmp/theflock-e2e-web.log 2>&1 & SERVER_PID=$!; trap "kill $SERVER_PID" EXIT; PLAYWRIGHT_BASE_URL=http://localhost:4173 PLAYWRIGHT_API_URL=http://api:3000 playwright test'
scripts.verify: docker compose exec api npm test --workspace api && docker compose exec api npm run test:coverage --workspace api && docker compose exec web npm test --workspace web && docker compose exec web npm run build --workspace web
